parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of the `join` filter by escaping the joining string only when `autoescape` is `on`. This may break existing templates that rely on the joining string being escaped regardless of the `autoescape` setting.
